title: Silent Focus Sentinel
summary: Catch silent and repeated VoiceOver focus stops in scripted iOS simulator runs.
user: Mobile app teams and VoiceOver users who need to catch focus stops that announce nothing before a release makes navigation confusing.
smallest_useful_product: An iOS simulator-focused CLI that records a scripted focus traversal, flags focusable nodes with empty/duplicate announcements, and emits a compact JSON/HTML diff.
success_measure: On a seeded regression suite, it flags at least 90% of intentional empty-focus stops with fewer than 10% false positives.
constraints: Keep artifacts local; allow ignored decorative nodes; do not claim WCAG conformance.
